name: khmer-dictionary
description: Look up Khmer words from the Chuon Nath dictionary — search panel, hover definitions, and look-up on selection.

commands.title: Khmer Dictionary: Voice Search (open panel and record)

khmerDictionary.enableHover.markdownDescription: Show a definition tooltip when hovering over Khmer text in the editor.

khmerDictionary.hoverMaxSenses.markdownDescription: Maximum number of senses (definitions) to show in a hover tooltip. `0` = show all.

khmerDictionary.audioServerUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the local audio server (`server.py`) used for the 🔊 pronunciation and 🎤 voice-search buttons. Prefer `127.0.0.1` over `localhost`: on Windows the name is resolved to IPv6 first and each request can wait ~2 s before falling back. The audio controls appear only when this server is running.

khmerDictionary.defaultVoice.markdownDescription: Voice selected by default in the panel's audio picker (used if that voice is available on the server).

enumDescriptions: Whisper running locally — no key, offline
khmerDictionary.sttEngine.markdownDescription: Speech-to-text engine for the 🎤 voice search, used if a key for it is configured in the audio server. See `API_ACCESS.md`.

khmerDictionary.autoPlayOnLookup.markdownDescription: Automatically play the pronunciation when a word is opened in the panel (requires the audio server).

khmerDictionary.panelResultLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of words to list in the panel for a search or a browsed letter.

khmerDictionary.serverScriptPath.markdownDescription: Path to `server.py`. The extension can start it for you (command **Start Audio Server**, or automatically when the panel opens) so you don't need a separate terminal. Leave blank to manage the server yourself.

khmerDictionary.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python executable used to launch the audio server.

khmerDictionary.autoStartServer.markdownDescription: When the panel opens, automatically start the audio server (using `serverScriptPath`) if it isn't already running.

khmerDictionary.recordSeconds.markdownDescription: How many seconds to record when the panel falls back to **host-side recording** (used when VS Code does not allow the webview to open the microphone). The server records with ffmpeg and returns the transcript.

khmerDictionary.muteAudio.markdownDescription: Silence all pronunciation audio (panel and hover). Toggled by the 🔊/🔇 button in the panel toolbar.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code colour theme
khmerDictionary.panelTheme.markdownDescription: Colours for the dictionary panel. Toggled by the ◐/☀/☾ button in the panel toolbar.
